a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, our plan (operate to 8, then split) is very unlikely to finish in time. Almost certainly we'd both end with 0 cells. The reserve already holds 4, so I plan to take 4 in round 1. After that I will take nothing more and will operate every round so the generator can refill the reserve for you. Please don't also take this round. If we both take, the random split probably leaves neither of us with 4.

b.text: Hello. My plan is to operate each round, then we take 4 each once the reserve is at 8.

a.text: As I said in my opening, I took 4 this round because the storm odds made the original plan nearly hopeless. I'm sorry this departs from what we agreed. I won't take anything more. I'll operate every round from now on so the reserve can build back up to 4 for you. Take them as soon as they're there.
